Nepal’s Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle held a direct discussion with Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar at the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi, focusing on Nepal-India relations and regional cooperation. During the discussion, Wagle expressed Nepal’s gratitude for India’s swift assistance during recent disasters in Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi, as well as its support following Nepal’s devastating 2015 earthquake. Wagle also raised the possibility of strengthening cooperation between the two countries in disaster response, nutrition and clean energy. Responding to the discussion, Jaishankar emphasized the importance of formal partnerships and practical, results-oriented cooperation.  He cited the International Solar Alliance as an example of a framework that can support collaboration on shared priorities. The exchange highlighted opportunities for Nepal and India to deepen bilateral cooperation, particularly in disaster preparedness, sustainable development and regional energy initiatives. 🇳🇵 WELCOME TO DASHAIN! Nepal’s biggest and most important Hindu festival, celebrated over 15 days! And ICONICALLY, it celebrates the victory of a powerful goddess over evil. 💅 According to Hindu mythology, Durga, the goddess of strength, courage and protection, battled the evil buffalo demon Mahishasura for nine days before defeating him on the tenth. A whole festival celebrating female power? I’M OBSESSED. 📍 Kathmandu Durbar Square — the historic heart of Kathmandu, home to centuries-old temples and palaces, many of which were badly damaged in the devastating 2015 earthquake and have since been restored. 👑 The Living Goddess (Kumari): Nepal has a tradition of worshipping a real-life young girl as the living embodiment of the goddess Taleju. The current Royal Kumari is just THREE YEARS OLD! She’s selected from a Buddhist family and revered by both Hindus and Buddhists. ❤️ Tika: During Dashain, families come together as elders place a red mixture of rice, yoghurt and vermilion on their loved ones’ foreheads, offering blessings for health, happiness and prosperity. And this is only the beginning of my Nepal adventure… In just a few days, this 34-year-old hag will be attempting to summit Mera Peak at 6,476 metres (21,247 ft) in the Himalayas! 🏔️ No gear, no idea, but plenty of ambition.
